name: Arc Converter - Automatic Item Processing
author: 민숙 MISO @m1nsook
shortDesc: Auto-process newly acquired weapons and clothes by tier, craft ammo, and sell junk for eddies

settings.label: Enable Arc Converter
settings.description: Master switch for automatic item processing.

settings.label: Weapons
settings.description: Automatically process only newly acquired weapons at the selected tiers. Existing weapons are not scanned.

settings.label: Weapon action
settings.description: Choose whether eligible newly acquired weapons are sold for eddies or disassembled into components.

settings.label: Tier 1 (+ variants)
settings.description: Process eligible Tier 1 weapons acquired after enabling the mod.

settings.label: Tier 1 (+ variants)
settings.description: Process eligible Tier 1 clothes acquired after enabling the mod.

settings.label: Automatically craft ammunition
settings.description: Use vanilla crafting and components to replenish ammunition for the currently equipped weapon.

settings.label: Craft when reserve below (%)
settings.description: Craft one vanilla recipe batch when ammunition falls below this percentage of its capacity. Never exceed the game's ammo limit.

settings.label: Automatically process junk
settings.description: Process junk and jewelry, including existing stacks, using the selected junk action.

settings.label: Junk action
settings.description: Sell, disassemble or use the unit price threshold. Ineligible items are kept.

settings.label: Price threshold (€$)
settings.description: In By value mode, disassemble at or below this unit price; sell above it.
